notes: Customer: regional integrated health system (multiple hospitals + ambulatory clinics). Heavy clinical notes + radiology reports indexing (~45M documents).
Primary ask: high-quality retrieval for physician queries against historical notes (RAG) with strict PHI controls. Emphasis on reranking to reduce hallucination risk + auditability.
Scale: estimate 40-60M docs, ~5B tokens after parsing; expected daily active queries ~500k (spiky during day), sustained QPS target 60-120 depending on window.
Latency targets: p50 <200ms for doc candidate retrieval + rerank pipeline end-to-end for short queries; willing to accept higher p99 for complex long-context tasks but prefer predictable SLOs.
Cost sensitivity: procurement asks for modeled cost-per-query < $0.02 for standard retrieval+rerank path; willing to pay more for private/dedicated capacity but need clear tradeoffs.
Security: CISO repeatedly: "PHI cannot traverse public endpoints; must live inside our VPC or air-gapped environment. Full audit logs required (user, token, request/response hashes)."
Integration constraints: existing vector store is a home-grown FAISS cluster; team wants Redwood to either integrate or provide migration tools. Also strict KMS + HSM requirement for key ops.

Retrieval strategy proposed by Praxis: cheap ANN for recall (lower-dim embeddings, cold storage), then small-domain-tuned reranker that runs in private subnet. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization + batching.
Quotes: Provider lead: "If we can get reliable reranking and clear audit trails, adoption among clinicians will jump — but first we need legal sign-off."
Redwood positioning notes: emphasize private deployment + audit logs, show sample cost projections for 50M doc index, propose 4-week on-prem POC with 2-node dedicated GPU pool and network diagram.
Risk flags: legal wants SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence for any hosted components; infra team demands network flow diagrams and port lists before any PoC VM is allowed on prem.
Decision criteria: security/compliance, predictable p50/p95 latency, cost per query at scale, supported reranking workflow and integration with FAISS, migration path for archived records.
Deal velocity: medium — CISO and procurement are gating; sales sees close in 2026 Q2 if PoC successful and legal sign-off occurs.
